claim_scope: Outcome-informed consumed-development diagnosis only; no unbiased success-rate, held-out, or leaderboard claim.
research_question: Which historical gpt-5.5 Official EnvBench failures remain failures under the current frozen A strong-Agent baseline, and what reproducible error mechanisms do they expose?

selection.policy: Select every consumed development case with an existing artifact-valid gpt-5.5 run that completed Official evaluation and recorded Official Fail.
selection.forbidden_use: Estimating population success rate or claiming held-out effectiveness

classification.confirmed_current_official_bad_case: Generation and submitted-program qualification complete, Official evaluator completes normally, and Official Pass is false.
classification.historical_only_resolved_case: Current frozen A obtains Official Pass; retain the old trajectory for history but exclude the case from the current hard set.
classification.algorithmic_noncompletion: The Agent fails to submit an admissible program or reaches an algorithmic timeout; retain as a separate terminal-error class, not as an Official-evaluated failure.
classification.infrastructure_unknown: Network, provider, host suspension, source acquisition, container, or evaluator infrastructure prevents a valid outcome; exclude and allow only a semantics-identical retry.
classification.boundary_failure: The submitted program fails hidden qualification before Official evaluation; analyze separately from Official bad cases.

decision_after_revalidation: Freeze only confirmed current Official failures as the initial consumed Dev hard set, cluster their causal errors, then decide whether more Dev screening is required before designing the next EnvSolve-Pro treatment.
